protocol.primary_cache_reason: scheduled before outer accuracy because this replay has complete native timing and graceful shutdown; not selected for performance
protocol.sensitivity_cache_limit: complete poses but missing final timing export; accuracy sensitivity only
protocol.observation: same bag and binary, paired 12440 frames; raw local 3D pose RMS difference 3.6012884865m and maximum 9.7876400463m; common-initial-gauge removal does not eliminate it
protocol.root_cause_status: unresolved; identical scan times and initial states, first rounded position difference at 80.199s; asynchronous map/rebuild scheduling is a hypothesis, not proven
protocol.freeze_rule: no freeze based on only one LIO cache; replay selected B3/B4/B5/B6 and final candidate with identical Q/R and policy parameters on both caches, no retuning on sensitivity cache
protocol.continuation_rule: apply original >=3% and >=0.1m primary improvement and normal/coverage constraints on both caches
protocol.numerical_effect_rule: minimum paired primary absolute improvement across caches must exceed the absolute difference between the two improvements; disclose the two-cache range rather than infer independent statistical confidence
protocol.candidate_budget_effect: replay numerical robustness does not add mechanism or tune configurations; all variants remain in the original <=3 revisions and <=12 main configurations per revision
